requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The tribunal this request is addressed to, written at the top - the one in which the marijuana case was heard
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The tribunal this request is addressed to, written at the top - the one in which the marijuana case was heard
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which tribunal heard the case is a case fact the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which tribunal heard the marijuana case - Superior Court, District Court, or the Traffic Tribunal - written at the top of the request; your BCI record or your old papers show it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number or citation number, as it appears on your records, if one appears
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number or citation number, as it appears on your records, if one appears
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number or citation number as it appears on your BCI record or court papers, if one appears - if none does, write none

requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: roughly what year the case was

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the case ended - a civil violation, a conviction, a plea of nolo contendere with a jail or suspended jail sentence, or a deferred sentence agreement whose period of deferment has not been completed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the case ended - a civil violation, a conviction, a plea of nolo contendere with a jail or suspended jail sentence, or a deferred sentence agreement whose period of deferment has not been completed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the case ended, in the section's own categories - note that the section's definition of conviction includes a nolo plea with a jail or suspended jail sentence and an incomplete deferred sentence agreement

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Amount of marijuana stated in the record, if the record states one
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Amount of marijuana stated in the record, if the record states one
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the amount the record states, if it states one - where it does not, the section presumes two ounces or less, and you write nothing

protectedBlanks.label: Signature on the request
protectedBlanks.why: you sign the request personally, and only after actually checking your BCI record - your signature makes the request's statements your own

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the request is signed would be false
